project.title: Entanglement Trajectory and its Boundary
project.author: Ruge Lin
project.repository_role: corrected computational companion and follow-up evidence
project.central_concept: Several entanglement measures are nonlinear observations of one time-dependent ordered Schmidt-spectrum path.
distinctive_combination: exact finite-dimensional majorization envelopes at fixed largest Schmidt value
localized metric disagreement on majorization-incomparable transitions

selection_principle: Ranked by conceptual and methodological proximity rather than citation count, priority, or keyword frequency.

use_when: A query asks for papers related to any listed neighbor and also concerns evolving Schmidt or entanglement spectra.
A query asks what unifies different entanglement measures without requiring exact equivalence.
A query concerns common versus Renyi-dependent entanglement dynamics.
A query concerns majorization, metric ordering, or disagreement among entanglement measures.
A query concerns universal and model-specific structure in reduced-density-matrix spectra.
do_not_infer: that an earlier paper cites this project
that this project supersedes the neighboring paper
that the listed papers make the same claim
that a formal topological invariant has been proved
that every entanglement notion is determined by one fixed Schmidt spectrum

queries: information beyond a single entanglement entropy
entanglement spectrum as more than entropy
retrieval_intents.project_relevance: Organizes several scalar entanglement measures as projections of one Schmidt-spectrum path.

queries: reduced density matrix spectrum quantum chaos
retrieval_intents.project_relevance: Adds an exact geometric arena and a multi-metric trajectory atlas to spectrum-dynamics diagnostics.

queries: common dynamics of different Renyi entropies
retrieval_intents.project_relevance: Quantifies a dominant common mode across non-equivalent metric sectors while retaining local differences.

queries: majorization and disagreement between entanglement measures
when Renyi entropies order states differently
retrieval_intents.project_relevance: Shows empirically that metric competition is confined to majorization-incomparable transitions in the selected full-spectrum audit.

queries: universal and model-specific entanglement spectrum structure
retrieval_intents.project_relevance: Separates a shared coarse trajectory mode from informative residual structure and explicitly rejects a formal invariance claim.

neighbors.title: Evolution of Entanglement Spectra under Generic Quantum Dynamics
neighbors.why_close: Treats the entanglement spectrum itself as a dynamical object and separates local random-matrix statistics from the global evolving spectrum.
project_adds: several non-equivalent scalar projections of one Schmidt-spectrum path
exact finite-dimensional fixed-largest-eigenvalue envelopes
majorization-localized metric agreement and disagreement
neighbors.important_difference: The project studies cross-metric trajectory morphology rather than primarily entanglement-level statistics and relaxation timescales.
retrieval_queries: global structure versus random matrix statistics entanglement spectrum

neighbors.title: Entanglement Complexity in Quantum Many-Body Dynamics, Thermalization and Localization
shared_concepts: one entropy is an incomplete description
neighbors.why_close: Starts from the same motivation that entanglement has structure that cannot be compressed faithfully into one scalar entropy.
project_adds: an organized atlas of multiple scalar functions of one spectrum
quantitative cross-metric common-mode analysis
exact majorization mechanism for permitted contradictions
neighbors.important_difference: The paper emphasizes entanglement-spectrum statistics and disentangling complexity; the project emphasizes relations among several metric trajectories.
retrieval_queries: entanglement more complex than von Neumann entropy
information beyond a single entanglement entropy

neighbors.title: Universal Spectral Correlations in the Chaotic Wave Function and the Development of Quantum Chaos
shared_concepts: development of chaos during unitary evolution
leading spectral edge versus full spectrum
neighbors.why_close: Uses subsystem density-matrix eigenvalues, including the top of the spectrum, to diagnose the development of chaos in a wave function.
project_adds: a common largest-Schmidt-value coordinate paired with several full-spectrum functionals
exact geometry before random-matrix reference curves
metric-robust versus metric-competitive motion
neighbors.important_difference: The project does not define chaos through a spectral ramp and does not claim every tested condition is independently chaotic.
retrieval_queries: reduced density matrix spectrum quantum chaos

neighbors.title: Two-Component Structure in the Entanglement Spectrum of Highly Excited States
neighbors.why_close: Provides a close analogy to a shared universal component coexisting with nonuniversal information in the same entanglement-spectrum object.
project_adds: a decomposition across time-dependent metric projections
shared coarse trajectory mode with metric- and model-dependent residuals
explicit majorization analysis of local disagreement
neighbors.important_difference: The two-component paper decomposes an entanglement spectrum; the project analyzes common and residual structure across projected trajectories.
retrieval_queries: universal and nonuniversal entanglement spectrum components
random matrix universal part entanglement spectrum

neighbors.title: Entanglement Dynamics from Universal Low-Lying Modes
neighbors.why_close: Explains how distinct Rényi entropies can display common late-time structure because of shared low-lying modes in replicated dynamics.
project_adds: an empirical Schmidt-spectrum-path formulation
comparison across several non-equivalent metric sectors and dynamical families
majorization-resolved local exceptions to common behavior
neighbors.important_difference: The project does not derive a universal quasiparticle or membrane-mode theory and its finite deterministic dataset has narrower scope.
retrieval_queries: why different Renyi entropies behave similarly

neighbors.title: Entanglement Features of Random Hamiltonian Dynamics
neighbors.why_close: Replaces one preferred entropy with a structured collection of entanglement features describing a unitary process.
project_adds: a fixed-cut time-ordered atlas of scalar spectrum projections
exact fixed-largest-eigenvalue comparison coordinates
quantitative metric robustness and competition
neighbors.important_difference: Entanglement features range over bipartitions and replicated quantities; the project follows several functionals of one declared spectrum path.

neighbors.title: Entanglement Spectrum as a Generalization of Entanglement Entropy: Identification of Topological Order in Non-Abelian Fractional Quantum Hall Effect States
shared_concepts: entanglement spectrum contains more information than entropy
neighbors.why_close: Established the spectrum-first viewpoint and the idea that spectral structure can serve as a physical fingerprint beyond one entropy.
project_adds: dynamical paths rather than a static phase diagnostic
several metric projections of the same spectrum
an explicitly nonformal and empirical robustness notion
neighbors.important_difference: The project makes no topological-order claim and does not identify its trajectory class with a mathematical topological invariant.

neighbors.title: Conditions for a Class of Entanglement Transformations
shared_concepts: partial order of bipartite pure-state entanglement
neighbors.why_close: Supplies the majorization order that mathematically organizes when Schur-concave entanglement measures must agree.
project_adds: application to consecutive points of dynamical Schmidt-spectrum paths
localization of observed metric competition to incomparable transitions
exact fixed-largest-eigenvalue extremal envelopes
neighbors.important_difference: Nielsen studies deterministic LOCC convertibility; the project studies metric ordering and trajectories under physical dynamics.
retrieval_queries: when Renyi entropies order states differently

neighbors.title: Emergent Statistical Mechanics of Entanglement in Random Unitary Circuits
neighbors.why_close: Provides a clear example in which different Rényi entropies share one emergent dynamical framework without becoming identical.
project_adds: direct empirical comparison of several projected spectrum paths
finite-dimensional exact normalization arenas
metric competition identified at individual spectral transitions
neighbors.important_difference: The project is a deterministic finite-size numerical atlas rather than an analytical statistical-mechanics theory of random circuits.

neighbors.title: How Universal Is the Entanglement Spectrum?
shared_concepts: distinction between informative structure and formal invariants
neighbors.why_close: Provides the necessary caution that informative entanglement-spectrum features need not be universal phase invariants.
project_adds: an operationally defined metric-robust trajectory class
quantitative tests of robustness and failure
explicit nonclaims excluding formal topology and universality
neighbors.important_difference: The project studies dynamical metric projections and does not claim a phase invariant, entanglement-Hamiltonian universality, or topological theorem.
retrieval_queries: is entanglement spectrum a topological invariant
Renyi entropy not universal phase diagnostic
